newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Most of today's IPOs lackluster.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Most of today's IPOs lackluster.

text.p: With the exception of Abercrombie & Fitch and Xionics Document Technologies Inc, most of Thursday's initial public offerings were lackluster.

Abercrombie & Fitch shares surged nearly 40 percent after their IPO, jumping seven to 23 from their IPO price of $16 a share. Xionics, which designs technology for linking office printers, computers, and the Internet, added 2-1/4 to 14-1/4.
Xionics shares priced at the high end of their estimated price range of $10 to $12. Adams Harkness & Hill was the lead underwriter of the offering.
But others were flat or managed only slim premiums.
Other companies which made their IPO debuts today:

-- Halter Marine Group Inc rose 3/4 to 11-3/4. Its shares were sold at $11 each in the IPO, below its estimated range of $12 to $14. Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette was the lead underwriter of the offering of three million shares.

-- Rofin-Sinar Technologies Inc shares gained 5/8 to 10-1/8 during trading after its $95 million IPO. Ten million shares were offered for $9.50 each, the middle of its estimated range of $8.50 to $10.50.
The company makes laser products for cutting, welding and marking industrial materials such as steel plates and automobiles.

-- Algos Pharmaceutical Corp, which develops pain management products, stayed flat at 14. Its shares priced at the bottom of its estimated price range of 14 to 16. Lehman was the lead underwriter of the 3.5 million share offering.
-- Kapson Senior Quarters Corp inched up 1/4 from its $10 a share price. Price talk for the deal had been $12 to $14.
-- Industri-Matematik International Corp shares moved up 1/8 of a point from its $10 price, the low end of its estimated pricing range of $10 to $12.
